key_highlights: ASX under pressure ahead of imminent RBA cash rate decision amid global equity market volatility.
Westpac posts $6.8B profit but warns of an accelerating 11% property price downturn.
Stubborn inflation and escalating public debt raise risks of a prolonged macroeconomic slowdown.
Cross-border M&A emerges as Rip Curl owner KMD Brands enters takeover talks with a US retail giant.

sectors.trend: Headline FY profits supported by historical margins, but headwinds mount from rising funding costs and housing slowdown.
sectors.implications: Mortgage growth is set to stall, and loan-impairment expenses will rise as residential property values fall.

sectors.trend: Property prices sliding for the seventh straight month, with valuation downgrades accelerating nationwide.
sectors.implications: Listed REITs (^AXRE) face sustained cap rate expansion and asset revaluation markdowns.

sectors.trend: Gold market capitulation contrasts with active small-cap exploration across WA gold and manganese plays.
sectors.implications: Junior miners face financing constraints; investors should focus on scale and disciplined balance sheets.

sectors.trend: Cost-of-living constraints drive retail distress and prompt opportunistic offshore acquisition interest.
sectors.implications: Traditional department stores suffer while brand portfolios attract takeover premiums.

sectors.trend: Critical diesel shortages threaten supply chains while grid transitions push retail power costs higher.
sectors.implications: Energy producers benefit from elevated prices, but broader industrial cost structures face inflation.

key_themes: Monetary tightening cycle triggering sharper domestic economic deceleration
Residential property correction depressing household wealth and credit expansion
Offshore equity weakness and geopolitical/electoral uncertainty weighing on risk assets
Energy transition friction and supply bottlenecks generating persistent cost pressures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA Policy Overshoot and Economic Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical equities; reallocate toward defensive cash, high-grade short-term debt, and quality dividend payers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Slump & Banking Credit Losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce direct exposure to major domestic mortgage lenders and residential property developers.
Hold energy hedges and favor supply-chain essential operators with pricing pass-through capabilities.
Maintain tactical index hedges and hold currency diversification via USD-denominated assets.

opportunities.recommendation: Arbitrage and M&A Upside in Apparel Retail
opportunities.rationale: Rip Curl owner KMD Brands receiving takeover interest provides potential valuation floor and upside premium.
Rising power tariffs and fuel supply tight spots protect cash flows for established energy producers.
Strong balance sheets and exposure to long-term energy transition metals provide downside buffer against spot gold weakness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim High-Multiple Major Banks and Mortgage Lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating house price falls and debt servicing strains threaten net interest margins and provisions.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement Downside Hedges on ASX Benchmark Indices
defensive_moves.rationale: Dual headwinds from RBA rate hikes and Wall Street selloffs increase vulnerability for broad equities.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX 200 expected to remain under selling pressure as market participants price in rate hikes and absorb offshore equity losses.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious. Slower economic growth and property repricing will constrain corporate earnings growth until inflation stabilizes.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decision and cash rate commentary
Australian housing credit and quarterly inflation prints
US midterm election outcomes and global market risk sentiment
FY26 banking full-year reporting and bad debt provisioning guidance
watch_list: AUD/USD and energy commodity price spreads
National diesel reserve levels and power wholesale price spikes
